title: Walmart-backed PhonePe shelves IPO as global tensions rattle markets | TechCrunch
summary: PhonePe, India’s largest digital payments platform, has postponed its IPO due to geopolitical tensions and volatile markets. The decision comes amid a global financial impact from Middle East conflicts, causing Indian stock indexes and oil prices to rise. The IPO, which could have raised significant funds for investors including Walmart, Tiger Global, and Microsoft, is now on hold as PhonePe awaits improved market conditions.
sentiment_reason: The IPO postponement reflects negative market sentiment due to geopolitical tensions and volatility, affecting investor confidence and stock market stability.
